newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTSR-China Cons and CSIRO form agreement.
newsitem.headline: RTSR-China Cons and CSIRO form agreement.

text.p: Construction group China Construction Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had formed a construction technology agreement with the Australian government's Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO).
China Construction and CSIRO said they would develop a strategic business plan over the next six months.

They said upon acceptance of the business plan by the two parties, China Construction will work closely with the CSIRO to commercialise construction software exclusively for China, Hong Kong and Macau.
The first software to be commercialised, ALign3D, has applications in highway and railway construction, they said.
China Constructions last traded on Monday at 46 cents, a rise of two cents on the day.
